title: Jonah and the Archive
author: Juniper Thackeray
blurb: Ivo Joubert, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, has spent seven years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
